scope: M2f F2 engine semantics and Admin-path regression evidence
result: passed; local single-player endpoint/runtime acceptance remains open

implementation.local_dispatch_mode: Explicit LocalSinglePlayer mode rejects unsupported conditions before operation admission: networking, non-normal game mode, paused mutation, and mutation for a non-local company. Read-only requests remain allowed while paused.
implementation.command_traits: All five Copilot command traits set NoEst so Shift cannot convert mutations into estimate-only commands.
implementation.callback: Post-return fallback records rejection only while the operation is still pending, preserving synchronous callback outcomes.
implementation.frame_stamps: Admin mode retains network-frame stamps for protocol-v3 compatibility. Local mode uses the save-persistent game tick, truncated to existing 32-bit response/COPL frame fields.
implementation.frame_limit: Protocol v4 must widen frame stamps and migrate retained outcomes, or define and test an explicit wrap boundary before claiming unbounded monotonicity.

tests.source_invariants: Covered local-mode guards, NoEst traits, frame selection, and synchronous callback fallback.

runtime_regressions.result: Passed exact error-byte cases across dispatcher kinds, wrong-world requests, malformed payload refusal/reconnect, and nonmutating guards.
Passed 44 operations costing 14979, two native deliveries, duplicate and budget refusals, all-outcome fresh-process reload and exact replay.
Passed same-bus insertion at index 1, 23 operations costing 3182, passenger service at all stops, and all 50 outcomes through fresh-process reload/replay.
